  n_iter: 10
  n_iter_simple: 1000
  n_workers: 4
  seed: 42
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true

execute:

```{r setup}
# Render with:
#   uv run quarto render docs/aipw_benchmark.qmd
# Override params from the CLI, e.g.:
#   uv run quarto render docs/aipw_benchmark.qmd -P n_iter:100 -P n_iter_simple:1000 -P n_workers:8
# Activate the pinned R library (docs/renv.lock). Quarto's knitr process runs
# with the repo root as its working directory, so docs/.Rprofile is never
# sourced -- load renv explicitly before any other package.
docs_dir <- dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE))
if (file.exists(file.path(docs_dir, "renv.lock"))) {
  renv::load(project = docs_dir, quiet = TRUE)
}

library(reticulate)
venv <- normalizePath(file.path(docs_dir, "..", ".venv"))
use_virtualenv(venv, required = TRUE)

library(qte)
library(RhpcBLASctl)

# qte's parallel bootstrap uses parallel::mclapply (fork). Forking a process
# with a multithreaded OpenBLAS deadlocks, so force BLAS/OpenMP to a single
# thread at runtime. RhpcBLASctl is a declared dependency (see docs/renv.lock).
blas_set_num_threads(1L)
omp_set_num_threads(1L)
pbapply::pboptions(type = "none")

N_ITER <- as.integer(params$n_iter)
N_ITER_SIMPLE <- as.integer(params$n_iter_simple)
N_WORKERS <- as.integer(params$n_workers)
SEED <- as.integer(params$seed)
QS <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)
QS_SIMPLE <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
X_R <- ~ age + I(age^2) + education + black + hispanic + married + nodegree
X_PY <- "age + I(age**2) + education + black + hispanic + married + nodegree"
```

```{r r-sequential}
set.seed(SEED)
t0 <- Sys.time()
res_r_seq <- unc_qte(
  yname = "re78", dname = "treat", data = lalonde.psid, xformla = X_R,
  probs = QS, est_method = "aipw", target = "qte", cl = 1, biters = N_ITER
)
r_seq_seconds <- as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs")

r_seq_vals <- list(
  qte = as.numeric(res_r_seq$qte), se = as.numeric(res_r_seq$qte.se),
  ate = as.numeric(res_r_seq$ate), ate_se = as.numeric(res_r_seq$ate.se)
)
```

```{r r-parallel}
set.seed(SEED)
t0 <- Sys.time()
res_r_par <- unc_qte(
  yname = "re78", dname = "treat", data = lalonde.psid, xformla = X_R,
  probs = QS, est_method = "aipw", target = "qte", cl = N_WORKERS, biters = N_ITER
)
r_par_seconds <- as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs")

r_par_vals <- list(
  qte = as.numeric(res_r_par$qte), se = as.numeric(res_r_par$qte.se),
  ate = as.numeric(res_r_par$ate), ate_se = as.numeric(res_r_par$ate.se)
)
```

```{r r-simple}
# Unconditional QTE with no covariates == R's IPW branch with x = NULL.
set.seed(SEED)
t0 <- Sys.time()
res_r_simple <- unc_qte(
  yname = "re78", dname = "treat", data = lalonde.psid, xformla = NULL,
  probs = QS_SIMPLE, est_method = "ipw", target = "qtt",
  cl = N_WORKERS, biters = N_ITER_SIMPLE
)
r_simple_seconds <- as.numeric(Sys.time() - t0, units = "secs")

r_simple_vals <- list(
  qte = as.numeric(res_r_simple$qte), se = as.numeric(res_r_simple$qte.se),
  ate = as.numeric(res_r_simple$ate), ate_se = as.numeric(res_r_simple$ate.se)
)
```

```{python}
#| label: py-sequential
import time

from qte.bootstrap import BootstrapConfig
from qte.cross_sectional import estimate_aipw_qte
from qte.datasets import load_lalonde

DATA = load_lalonde(controls_source="psid")
qs = [float(q) for q in r.QS]

cfg = BootstrapConfig(n_iter=int(r.N_ITER), seed=int(r.SEED), n_workers=1)
t0 = time.perf_counter()
res_py_seq = estimate_aipw_qte(
    DATA, "re78", "treat", qs=qs,
    ps_x_formular=r.X_PY, or_x_formular=r.X_PY, bootstrap_config=cfg,
)
py_seq_seconds = time.perf_counter() - t0
```

```{python}
#| label: py-parallel
cfg = BootstrapConfig(n_iter=int(r.N_ITER), seed=int(r.SEED), n_workers=int(r.N_WORKERS))
t0 = time.perf_counter()
res_py_par = estimate_aipw_qte(
    DATA, "re78", "treat", qs=qs,
    ps_x_formular=r.X_PY, or_x_formular=r.X_PY, bootstrap_config=cfg,
)
py_par_seconds = time.perf_counter() - t0
```

```{python}
#| label: py-simple
from qte.cross_sectional import estimate_simple_qte

qs_simple = [float(q) for q in r.QS_SIMPLE]
cfg = BootstrapConfig(n_iter=int(r.N_ITER_SIMPLE), seed=int(r.SEED), n_workers=int(r.N_WORKERS))
t0 = time.perf_counter()
res_py_simple = estimate_simple_qte(DATA, "re78", "treat", qs=qs_simple, bootstrap_config=cfg)
py_simple_seconds = time.perf_counter() - t0
```

```{python}
#| label: tables
import polars as pl
from great_tables import GT

order = [f"QTE({q:.2f})" for q in qs] + ["ATE"]


def py_cols(res):
    rows = {f"QTE({row['q']:.2f})": (row["effect"], row["se"]) for row in res.qtt.iter_rows(named=True)}
    rows["ATE"] = (res.att["effect"][0], res.att["se"][0])
    return [rows[k][0] for k in order], [rows[k][1] for k in order]


def r_cols(vals):
    eff = [float(x) for x in vals["qte"]] + [float(vals["ate"])]
    err = [float(x) for x in vals["se"]] + [float(vals["ate_se"])]
    return eff, err


py_seq_e, py_seq_s = py_cols(res_py_seq)
py_par_e, py_par_s = py_cols(res_py_par)
r_seq_e, r_seq_s = r_cols(r.r_seq_vals)
r_par_e, r_par_s = r_cols(r.r_par_vals)

numeric = ["py_seq_est", "py_seq_se", "py_par_est", "py_par_se",
           "r_seq_est", "r_seq_se", "r_par_est", "r_par_se"]

table = pl.DataFrame({
    "quantity": order,
    "py_seq_est": py_seq_e, "py_seq_se": py_seq_s,
    "py_par_est": py_par_e, "py_par_se": py_par_s,
    "r_seq_est": r_seq_e, "r_seq_se": r_seq_s,
    "r_par_est": r_par_e, "r_par_se": r_par_s,
})

table_html = (
    GT(table)
    .tab_spanner("Python — sequential", columns=["py_seq_est", "py_seq_se"])
    .tab_spanner("Python — parallel", columns=["py_par_est", "py_par_se"])
    .tab_spanner("R — sequential", columns=["r_seq_est", "r_seq_se"])
    .tab_spanner("R — parallel", columns=["r_par_est", "r_par_se"])
    .cols_label(
        quantity="", py_seq_est="est", py_seq_se="se",
        py_par_est="est", py_par_se="se", r_seq_est="est", r_seq_se="se",
        r_par_est="est", r_par_se="se",
    )
    .fmt_number(columns=numeric, decimals=1, use_seps=True)
    .tab_source_note("Bootstrap standard errors. py-qte: AIPW mean; R unc_qte: IPW-based ATE.")
    .as_raw_html()
)

timing = pl.DataFrame({
    "model": ["Python — sequential", "Python — parallel", "R — sequential", "R — parallel"],
    "workers": [1, int(r.N_WORKERS), 1, int(r.N_WORKERS)],
    "iterations": [int(r.N_ITER)] * 4,
    "seconds": [py_seq_seconds, py_par_seconds, float(r.r_seq_seconds), float(r.r_par_seconds)],
})

timing_html = (
    GT(timing)
    .cols_label(model="", workers="workers", iterations="bootstrap iters", seconds="seconds")
    .fmt_number(columns=["seconds"], decimals=1)
    .as_raw_html()
)

# --- simple / unconditional QTE (no covariates) -----------------------------
simple_order = [f"QTE({q:.2f})" for q in qs_simple] + ["ATE"]


def py_simple_cols(res):
    rows = {f"QTE({row['q']:.2f})": (row["effect"], row["se"]) for row in res.qtt.iter_rows(named=True)}
    rows["ATE"] = (res.att["effect"][0], res.att["se"][0])
    return [rows[k][0] for k in simple_order], [rows[k][1] for k in simple_order]


def r_simple_cols(vals):
    eff = [float(x) for x in vals["qte"]] + [float(vals["ate"])]
    err = [float(x) for x in vals["se"]] + [float(vals["ate_se"])]
    return eff, err


pys_e, pys_s = py_simple_cols(res_py_simple)
rs_e, rs_s = r_simple_cols(r.r_simple_vals)

simple_table = pl.DataFrame({
    "quantity": simple_order,
    "py_est": pys_e, "py_se": pys_s,
    "r_est": rs_e, "r_se": rs_s,
})

simple_table_html = (
    GT(simple_table)
    .tab_spanner("Python simple_qte", columns=["py_est", "py_se"])
    .tab_spanner("R unc_qte (ipw, x = NULL)", columns=["r_est", "r_se"])
    .cols_label(quantity="", py_est="est", py_se="se", r_est="est", r_se="se")
    .fmt_number(columns=["py_est", "py_se", "r_est", "r_se"], decimals=1, use_seps=True)
    .tab_source_note(
        "Unconditional QTE (no covariates). Estimates match except p90, where the packages "
        "use different quantile definitions (NumPy linear/type 7 vs BMisc weighted_quantile)."
    )
    .as_raw_html()
)

simple_timing_html = (
    GT(pl.DataFrame({
        "model": ["Python simple_qte", "R unc_qte (ipw, x = NULL)"],
        "workers": [int(r.N_WORKERS), int(r.N_WORKERS)],
        "iterations": [int(r.N_ITER_SIMPLE)] * 2,
        "seconds": [py_simple_seconds, float(r.r_simple_seconds)],
    }))
    .cols_label(model="", workers="workers", iterations="bootstrap iters", seconds="seconds")
    .fmt_number(columns=["seconds"], decimals=1)
    .as_raw_html()
)
```
